title: The AI-Driven Programming Language Trend
full_monologue: Bold: AI is pushing everyone to learn a new programming language. It’s not just developers anymore—marketers, teachers, even artists are getting dragged into code. Why? Because AI tools now require basic scripting to customize outputs. We’re seeing a surge in demand for Python, JavaScript, and even no-code platforms. It’s reshaping how we interact with technology. But is this a skill everyone should learn? Let me know in the comments.
